subject.title: Add Rovo Dev provider with monthly credit tracking

question: Should CodexBar ship an experimental Rovo provider only after it can honor Rovo Dev’s selected billing site, or should the feature be narrowed to a supported CLI-derived integration instead of guessing an undocumented credits/check parameter or header?
rationale: The code can be mechanically extended only after maintainers choose a durable provider-contract boundary; Atlassian documents the selected allocation but not the credits endpoint’s cloud-ID wire format.

options.title: Pause for verified site-aware contract
options.body: Keep this PR open until an authoritative source or entitled multi-site verification establishes how credits/check receives the selected billing-site context.

options.title: Rework around the CLI boundary
options.body: Narrow the provider to parse or otherwise consume a supported local Rovo Dev CLI output that already respects the configured billing site.

options.title: Accept account-level experimental behavior
options.body: Merge with clearly documented risk that multi-site and Free allocations can be inaccurate or unavailable.

recommendation.title: Pause for verified site-aware contract
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until an authoritative source or entitled multi-site verification establishes how credits/check receives the selected billing-site context.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch history and the latest maintainer review show direct ownership of the implementation and provider-contract acceptance decision.
